# #15 Zoom viewer — blind adversarial QA

**Verdict: FAIL**, on one major defect (D1). Every AC passes as written. D1 breaks the rule 11 keyboard contract after any mouse or touch use of the stage.

Method: Playwright drivers in `.verify/qa/15/` (`qa.mjs` is the main driver, `probe*.mjs` are targeted repros), each run via `scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- node …` (prod build). Test doc: an 11-node LR flowchart (natural width 3200px); 800×600, 16×16, linked, broken, no-alt and SVG (`<img>`) images; tiny, sequence, gantt, pie and `%%{init}%%` diagrams; a syntax error; a diagram in a folded section and one in a `<details>`. I did not read src/ or the diff. Results: `.verify/qa/15/results.txt`.

## AC verdicts
- AC-15.1 PASS: 8 mermaid and 3 image triggers, all with tabindex 0, role=button and cursor zoom-in. The aria-labels follow the spec exactly, alt omitted when empty.
- AC-15.2 PASS: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, label "Diagram viewer". The first node's fill matches the page (rgb(238,238,238) on both).
- AC-15.3 PASS: drag-selecting across flowchart labels and across sequence text gives a selection and shows `.selection-action-bar`. The viewer stays closed.
- AC-15.4 PASS: at 390×844 the viewer opens at 11%. Four taps on `zoom-in-btn` reach 109%. At exactly 100% the width is 3200.48px against a natural width of 3200.48.
- AC-15.5 PASS: wheel zoom 43→64%, the point under the cursor drifts 0.00px, and the page `scrollY` stays at 0. Ctrl+wheel also zooms.
- AC-15.6 PASS: a 100px drag moves the content 100.0px. After over-dragging, exactly 48px stays visible.
- AC-15.7 PASS: a CDP two-finger pinch goes 11→56% with 0px midpoint drift, and `visualViewport.scale` stays 1. A one-finger pan moves the content −60px for a −60px drag.
- AC-15.8 PASS: Enter opens the viewer with focus on `zoom-close-btn`. `+`, `-` and `0` work. Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the dialog. Esc closes it and focus returns to the trigger. Space also opens it.
- AC-15.9 PASS: after reset, scale and box match the values at open to under 1px.
- AC-15.10 PASS: zoom-in disables at 400% and zoom-out at 21%. Both match the formulas for fit=0.43.
- AC-15.11 PASS: the clipboard holds the exact fence. The sequence diagram keeps `-->` with no `&gt;`, and the "Copied" feedback shows.
- AC-15.12 PASS: the 16×16 icon, the image inside `<a>` and the broken image are not triggers.
- AC-15.13 PASS: in all 6 themes the background equals `--bg-surface` and toolbar contrast is between 5.25 and 17.6:1. I checked every `theme-*.png`; the Locus themes use Locus fonts and buttons.
- AC-15.14 PASS: the page was scrolled to 400 before opening the image viewer, and after a background-click close `scrollY` is 400 again. The in-page SVG is unchanged.
- AC-15.15 PASS: `desk-400.png` shows crisp vector text. The SVG is sized by width and its parent uses only a translate.

## Other rules and edge cases (pass)
- Rule 16: a server PUT reached the page while the viewer was open. The viewer stayed open on its snapshot, and the triggers were re-marked after close.
- Rule 17: the print media query hides the viewer and the zoom cursor.
- Rule 14: at 100% on a phone, both the right edge and the left edge can be panned to the 48px clamp, so every corner is reachable.
- Double-tap gives 11→100% and back. The tiny diagram opens at 200% and double-click takes it to 500%.
- Rotating to 844×390 keeps the content centred, and Reset recomputes fit (11→25%).
- Tablet and phone buttons are at least 44×44, and the phone toolbar fits within 390px.
- A diagram unfolded from a folded section and one inside an expanded `<details>` both open.
- After a theme toggle, the viewer shows the new colours.
- Opening and closing 8 times rapidly leaves nothing behind. Esc during the "Copied" feedback closes only the viewer.
- Gantt, pie and sequence diagrams open. The mermaid error block is not a trigger.
- No console errors or page errors.

## Defects
- **D1 — major — keyboard is dead after any mouse or touch interaction with the stage.**
  - Repro: open a diagram, then click, drag or double-click the content or background. `document.activeElement` becomes BODY, outside the dialog. Esc then does not close the viewer, and `+`, `-`, `0` and the arrows do nothing.
  - Effect: rule 11 ("Esc closes", keys work while the dialog is open) breaks in the most common flow, which is pan then Esc. Tab does bring focus back into the dialog.
  - Evidence: `probe5.mjs` sections B and B2, and `esc-stuck-*.png` from `qa.mjs`.
- **D2 — minor — focus is lost when the focused button disables.**
  - Repro: focus `zoom-in-btn` and press Enter repeatedly until max zoom. When the button disables, focus drops to BODY, with the same effect as D1 (Esc is dead).
  - Evidence: `probe5.mjs` section A.

Not tested: Esc layering against other open layers (no drawer or modal open at the same time). Slides (#29) and split view (#7) have not landed.
